title: What was the largest ethnic group in Oxford County school districts in 2024-25?
text:
What was the largest ethnic group in Oxford County school districts in 2024-25?
The majority of students in Oxford County school districts were white in the 2024-25 school year, according to the Maine Department of Education.
Of the 8,110 students enrolled in Oxford County district schools, 92.3% were white. Multiracial students were the second-largest ethnic group among students in Oxford County school districts, accounting for 3.1% of enrollment.
In the previous school year, white students were also the most common group in Oxford County, representing 92.3% of enrollment.
Regional School Unit 17/Maine School Administrative District 17 reported the widest range of ethnic groups in the county, including white, multiracial, Hispanic or Latino, Asian, Black, and American Indian or Alaskan Native.
In the 2024-25 school year, total enrollment in county public school districts decreased 2.6% from the previous year.
The main offices of all school districts mentioned in the story are located in cities associated with Oxford County.
As of 2025, the average student-to-teacher ratio in public schools in Maine is 11-to-1, much lower than the national average of 15-to-1. A lower student-to-teacher ratio has been found to improve students' school performance.
Public school enrollment in Maine fell to its lowest level in a decade in the 2024-25 school year, dropping below even the sharp decline seen after the COVID-19 pandemic. The state reported approximately 171,000 students enrolled that year.
